concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to abort if fewer than 50 paired species are obtained. The plan instead proposes a fallback to a verified placeholder dataset, which directly violates the abort requirement.

FR-009 mandates validation of identified metabolite classes against an external curated literature list. The plan acknowledges the external list cannot be fetched and skips the overlap calculation, leaving FR-009 unsatisfied.
FR-010 (independent validation set performance reporting) is not explicitly referenced in the Phase/Task Mapping table, making it unclear whether the requirement is addressed.
